title: Memory leak causing OOM restarts — payment-service
symptoms: payment-service pod restarted 3 times in 4 hours with OOMKilled status
Heap memory growing monotonically ~50 MB/hour since v1.8.2 deploy
Garbage collector running at maximum frequency; memory not reclaimed

recent_deploys.description: Feature: PDF receipt generation using Pillow for logo embedding

_ground_truth.root_cause: Memory leak introduced in v1.8.2. receipt_generator.generate_pdf() opens PIL/Pillow Image objects for logo embedding and never closes them. Each transaction leaks approximately 45 KB. At ~360 receipts/hour the heap grows ~16 MB/hour from Image objects alone; additional unreleased BytesIO buffers account for the remaining ~35 MB/hour growth. Python's reference counting does not collect these because they are captured in the receipt cache dict.
resolution_steps: Option A (immediate): roll back to v1.8.1 to stop the leak.

Option B (fix forward): In receipt_generator.py line 87, replace `img = Image.open(LOGO_PATH)` with a context manager: `with Image.open(LOGO_PATH) as img:` and move all logo-compositing logic inside the block.
Also ensure BytesIO buffers created on line 112 are closed after upload to S3: call `buf.close()` after `s3_client.put_object(...)`.
Verify: deploy the fix, monitor heap for 30 minutes; growth should drop below 2 MB/hour (baseline).
